verdict.rationale: Apify's docs and site clearly describe building custom Actors (serverless scraping scripts) using Python/JS toolkits and frameworks like Crawlee/Playwright/Puppeteer/Scrapy, deploying them to the cloud platform without infrastructure management, plus CLI, API, scheduling, monitoring, and proxy support. Community feedback corroborates it as a strong developer-oriented scraping platform, though some raise performance/serverless nuance questions.
